card.name: Verbs in old formal historical prose
card.fires_on: Verbs, auxiliaries and word endings inside long, formal 18th and 19th century prose, such as Federalist-style political argument or old scientific writing. It responds on a word that continues a clause, such as would, be, has, presented or producing.
